title: Born in the French Quarter; no musical family
summary: He was born on St. Philip Street in the French Quarter; nobody in his family played and nobody taught him drums.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You were born right here in New Orleans?
Right here in New Orleans, yes.
I think you told us the other time about what street it was, what part of town?
Right around here. In the French Quarter? In the French Quarter, yes. Born on St. Philip, between Burgundy and Dauphin.
Did your father play any music?
How come you took up drums so young?
Well, it's just a gift. Nobody taught me whatsoever.
